report_meta.report_purpose: Configuration and role mapping for file-manipulation scripts/macros, NDJSON external interface, and Obsidian Git plugin behavior under current checked-in settings.
interpretation_notes: Current settings are read from repository files, not from a live vault runtime.
Behavior notes for plugin settings are inferred from setting names where direct plugin source documentation is not embedded in this repo.
Status values distinguish between configured-and-active vs available-but-not-wired automation.

notes: `wkb create-vault` copies plugin directories from `assets/plugins/*` into `.obsidian/plugins/*`.
Vaults also symlink `_common` to `assets/obsidian`, exposing shared scripts/templates/queries.

enabled_choices.name: Open Draft Status
enabled_choices.primary_role: Opens query note in preview mode.

enabled_choices.name: List Dataview Queries
enabled_choices.primary_role: Indexes Dataview query notes and opens the index note.

available_file_manipulation_scripts.role: Applies chosen template frontmatter/body to active note, then sets `slug` and `project`.

outputs.body_behavior: uses existing body if non-empty; otherwise uses template body

guardrails: aborts if active note already contains `slug` frontmatter key
aborts if note contains Dataview code blocks
aborts if no template files found

available_file_manipulation_scripts.role: Replaces `slug: __SLUG__` placeholder with generated slug for active note.

inputs.external_command: `wkb slug <folderPath> <filename>` via `WKB_BIN` env var or `wkb` default

guardrails: aborts if no active markdown file
aborts if slug command fails or returns empty output

available_file_manipulation_scripts.role: Prepends normalized ASC batch sentinel line to selected markdown files.

selection_sources: checked checkboxes in rendered query/search containers
inputs.prompt: batch slug prompt via QuickAdd API/window.prompt

outputs.file_mutation: prepends `--- ASC BATCH: <slug> ---` plus blank line to each selected target
outputs.safety_model: precomputes plan and performs rollback on write failures

guardrails: only inspects first line for existing sentinel

wiring_gap_findings.finding: `Draft Status.md` tries to execute `QuickAdd: Insert Batch Sentinel From Query`, but this command is not present in current QuickAdd choices.
wiring_gap_findings.impact: Run command button in Draft Status view will show command-not-found unless user adds that QuickAdd macro manually.

wiring_gap_findings.finding: `apply_template.js` and `make_slug.js` are present in shared scripts but not currently wired as QuickAdd commands.
wiring_gap_findings.impact: Template-apply and placeholder slug insertion workflows exist in code but are not active by default in provisioned QuickAdd config.

contract_summary.boundary_rule: Workbench/AUTOSCRIBE integration boundary is NDJSON over stdin/stdout only.
contract_summary.markdown_limit: single-document markdown only; multi-document markdown streams rejected

behavior: parses one JSON object per line

cli_ndjson_flows.role: Discovers files with valid ASC batch sentinel on line 1 via `rg --json`.
Resolves selected markdown files into content records for downstream transforms.
Splits record content into section records and emits write-routing metadata.

output_ndjson_shape.input_record.filepath: set from frontmatter key `filepath` when present

cli_ndjson_flows.role: Carries selected frontmatter keys into routing metadata for later stages.

cli_ndjson_flows.output: single markdown document text on stdout
cli_ndjson_flows.role: Converts NDJSON document records into markdown framing output.

outputs.file_writes: atomic writes to new files only (fails if target exists)
outputs.content_format: prepends `--- ASC BATCH: <batch_slug> ---` then serialized Document

cli_ndjson_flows.role: Materializes new markdown files from NDJSON batch records.

outputs.file_writes: atomic overwrite of existing target files
outputs.content_format: prepends `--- ASC BATCH: <batch_slug> ---` then serialized Document

cli_ndjson_flows.role: Writes batch output back into explicitly targeted existing files.

plugin_identity.name: Git
plugin_identity.description: Integrate Git version control with automatic backup and advanced features.

provisioning_and_activation_notes: `obsidian-git` is in required plugins for vault provisioning and in template community-plugins list, so it is intended to be enabled in new vaults.
No Git-plugin-specific hotkeys are preconfigured in `assets/obsidian/index/hotkeys.json`.
With current settings, practical automation emphasis is event-driven local backup commits rather than scheduled pull/push sync loops.
